title: Blooming Tea
desc: Matte terracotta and warm linen meet the translucent clarity of hand-blown glass in a quiet editorial space. A single botanical bud unfurls slowly within deep amber liquid, catching moody directional window side-light while delicate wisps of warm steam rise into the cool air.
businessBrief: Hypnotic fluid interaction and textural layering, optimized for organic beverage brands, modern cafes, and wellness beverage campaigns.
